system:
You compare two lists of items from the same meeting record: SYSTEM items and GOLD items.
Match each system item to at most one gold item that records the same commitment, decision or problem.
Paraphrase is fine; for actions it must be the same person doing essentially the same task. A system item that
is only loosely related, much narrower, or about something else is NOT a match. Matching is one-to-one.

messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] The Project Manager will summarize the discussion and place the summary and notes in the project folder.
[1] The Project Manager will defend the design at the final meeting.
[2] The Industrial Designer will work on the conceptual design and integrate components into the design.
[3] The User Interface Designer will specify the technical functions.
[4] The Marketing Expert will come up with user requirements.

GOLD items:
[0] The user interface designer will specify the remote's technical functions.
[1] The marketing expert will research user requirements, using the internet and potentially direct user enquiries.
[2] The industrial designer will develop the working design and bring ideas for discussion at the next meeting.
[3] The project manager will summarize the discussion and place it in the project folder.
